projects.name: Hannibal and Hopedale, Ohio data centers
projects.quote: Yesterday, we announced the acquisition of two operational data centers in Hannibal and Hopedale, Ohio, with 222 megawatts of interconnect-approved capacity.

projects.name: Findlay, Ohio operation
projects.quote: Simultaneously, we have begun developing a 150-megawatt operation in Findlay, Ohio, which already has 30 megawatts of capacity.

projects.name: Garden City, TX facility
projects.quote: MARA’s Garden City, TX facility: 100 MW powered, 5.4 EH/s from 40,800 miners, adjacent to a wind farm, with potential to expand to 200 MW

projects.name: NGON micro data center operation
projects.quote: In October, we announced a partnership with NGON, a privately held methane neutralization company, to launch a 25 MW micro data center operation across wellheads in Texas and North Dakota.
